E-mail link → verify button → consent page
Consent + PIN shows Explorer name
Child session starts at character welcome (no assessment)
Onboarding steps → first Daily Word Quest
Learn 10 words, answer all rounds, receive XP celebration
Dashboard reflects XP & coins after reload
No uncaught JS errors during the journey
